name: misaka-gpt-image-agent
description: Generate and edit images with GPT Image 2 through a local MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Generate and edit images with GPT Image 2.
interface.longDescription: GPT Image Agent adds local MCP tools for GPT Image 2 text-to-image generation, batch generation, and image editing. It saves generated files locally and reads API keys from config/config.json.
defaultPrompt: Generate an image with GPT Image 2
Edit this local image with GPT Image 2
